title: AMD Zen 6 Analyzed: Chiplets, Memory Controller, Core Changes
summary: Chips and Cheese published an analysis of AMD&\#x27;s Zen 6 processor family, covering changes to the CPU core microarchitecture and to the chiplet and memory-subsystem design. The analysis examines branch prediction, execution resources, chiplets, and the memory controller for an upcoming processor family rather than a finalized AMD product release. Its details should therefore be read as forward-looking architectural analysis, not confirmed shipping specifications.

references.title: AMD’s Zen 6 Family: Feeding the Beast - by George Cozma
